name: moterva
description: MOTERVA Mission Treasury — mission-scoped financial autonomy engine for physical operations (hackathon build; no production money movement).

scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/domain packages/providers packages/ledger packages/airwallex packages/metal
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @moterva/api" "npm run dev -w @moterva/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json && npm run typecheck -w @moterva/web && npm run typecheck -w @moterva/api && npm run typecheck -w @moterva/ledger && npm run typecheck -w @moterva/domain && npm run typecheck -w @moterva/providers && npm run typecheck -w @moterva/airwallex && npm run typecheck -w @moterva/metal && npm run typecheck -w @moterva/planner
